# Maan Tour & Travels

> Taxi service based in Jalandhar, Punjab, India. Specialises in Delhi to Jalandhar and Jalandhar to Delhi taxi (one-way and round trip, including Delhi IGI airport pickup and drop), plus airport transfers, outstation cabs, luxury car hire, wedding cars, self-drive rentals, Tempo Travellers and tour packages across Punjab, Delhi, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan and Jammu & Kashmir. Available 24/7.

Maan Tour & Travels has served travellers across North India for over 15 years. The business operates a fleet of 50+ vehicles including sedans, SUVs, MPVs, luxury cars and Tempo Travellers, all professionally maintained and driven by experienced taxi drivers.

Popular routes: Delhi ⇄ Jalandhar, Jalandhar to Delhi Airport, Amritsar to Delhi, Jalandhar to Amritsar, Jalandhar to Chandigarh, Jalandhar to Ludhiana, Jalandhar to Jaipur, and tours to Manali, Dalhousie, Dharamshala, Haridwar and Khatu Shyam.

Cities served include Jalandhar, Amritsar, Ludhiana, Phagwara, Kapurthala, Hoshiarpur, Pathankot, Mohali, Patiala, Bathinda, Chandigarh, Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ambala, Karnal, Panipat, Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and in Himachal Pradesh: Shimla, Manali, Kullu, Dharamshala, McLeod Ganj, Dalhousie, Kasauli, Palampur, Kangra, Una and Chintpurni.

## Services

- [Taxi / Cab Booking](https://www.maantravels.com/go-taxi): One-way, round-trip and local taxi from Jalandhar, including Delhi ⇄ Jalandhar cabs
- [Airport Transfers](https://www.maantravels.com/airport-transfer): Pickup and drop for Delhi IGI, Amritsar, Chandigarh, Halwara (Ludhiana) and Adampur airports
- [Luxury Car Hire](https://www.maantravels.com/luxury-cars): Luxury cars with professional drivers for events, corporate travel and special occasions
- [Wedding Cars](https://www.maantravels.com/wedding-cars): Decorated luxury vehicles for weddings and baraat processions in Jalandhar and Punjab
- [Self Drive Rentals](https://www.maantravels.com/self-drive): Self-drive car rentals by the day
- [Tempo Traveller & Urbania](https://www.maantravels.com/tempo-traveller-urbania): Group travel vehicles for 9–26 passengers
- [Tour Packages](https://www.maantravels.com/tour-packages): Custom taxi tours to Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Rajasthan and religious destinations
- [Fixed Tour Packages](https://www.maantravels.com/packages): Amritsar darshan, Dalhousie, Dharamshala and Kashmir packages
